note: City of Valentine 40-acre park on North Main Street, just outside town, along Minnechaduza Creek. Primitive camping on undesignated gravel pull-offs beside the park road; low oak branches (a 32-ft Class C got through in 2023). Water spigots around the park; water and restrooms typically shut off in the off-season. No dump station noted. Mill Pond across the road is stocked. CAMPER-REPORTED RATE: $5 (9/2024) and $10 (4/2024) a night, self-pay drop box (RV Life reviews); no city page posts a rate. --Claude
summary: No city page exists for the park; Cherry County Tourism confirms year-round camping and free hot showers (reported). Camper-reported $5/$10 (2024) written as reported fees. Inclusion is shaky: RV Life reviewers describe undesignated pull-offs, no pads. Directory-only site length/pull-through cleared. Waterfront: suggest creekside -> not waterfront (treed bank, undesignated sites).
flags: INCLUSION QUESTION (designated sites vs informal parking): no official source describes RV sites. Imagery shows a wide gravel apron along the park road with a fire ring and picnic table, no marked pads or pedestals. RV Life: 4/2015 [9] 'the campsites are an undesignated area on the left side of the road next to the ...'; 8/2006 [2] 'Sites, if you can call them that are wherever you want to pull over along the road'; 4/2024 [6] 'Sites are small and ...'; 9/2024 [8] 'worked well for an overnight with a smaller trailer ... Most campsites for trailers were ...'. Campendium files it as 'Valentine City Park Dispersed Camping'. It is a city park that sells camping nights (self-pay) with restrooms and showers, so it may stay as a primitive town campground - AWH's call.

WATERFRONT (suggest creekside -> not waterfront): the gravel apron at the pin is ~10-30 m from Minnechaduza Creek (~5-8 m wide, creek class), but the creek runs under a continuous riparian tree belt that starts at the apron's edge, and with no designated sites there is no pad to measure an open apron from. Stored value has no per-entry evidence (commit 9af42bc). Unsure, so down. No creek-view class exists.

RATE: no operator page; camper-reported $5 (RV Life 9/2024) and $10 (RV Life 4/2024), written as reported fees with a CAMPER-REPORTED RATE note line, per the camper-report rule. Directories range from free to $10.
PHONE: no official phone found; directories give 402-376-2323 (unverified, not written). Entry has no phone.
PIN OK: stored 42.88620,-100.54700 is on the gravel camping apron by the road.
